scope: Public official-source verification for missing computational predictors; no downloads performed by this audit, no patient queries, and no terms/contracts accepted.

candidates_install_now.release: v1.3 (official score file dated page updates May 2021; GRCh37 plus lifted GRCh38 coordinate column)

files.name: revel-v1.3_all_chromosomes.zip
files.format: CSV; 9 fields incl chr, GRCh37/GRCh38 position, REF/ALT, amino acid, score, Ensembl transcript IDs

candidates_install_now.license_access: Official page states free for non-commercial use; contact authors for other uses. Direct download link hosted at Mount Sinai; an alternative Zenodo record is linked. No account/contract stated on page.
candidates_install_now.adapter: Ensembl VEP REVEL plugin exists. Convert CSV to tab-separated; retain records with GRCh38 coordinate; sort/index with bgzip/tabix (tabix dependency required); match exact genomic REF/ALT plus transcript ID and amino-acid change. Add locally versioned plugin file and run public controls.
candidates_install_now.why_candidate: The only clearly advertised compact whole-score file in this audit; much smaller than whole-genome score resources. Given explicit non-commercial terms, don't proceed if project use is commercial/unclear.

not_now.release: Official SpliceAI repository documents precomputed score files but does not identify a dated current score release on the accessed README; original package uses GENCODE v24 canonical annotations, D=50 default. Code version is not a data release.

files.name: all possible substitutions, 1-bp insertions, 1-4 bp deletions within genes (per official README)
files.official_size: not stated on official download page

not_now.license_access: Officially free for academic and not-for-profit use; commercial license from Illumina required. Precomputed downloads are linked to Illumina BaseSpace. VEP docs/community estimates are about 15.5 GB SNV + 4.5 GB indel for GRCh38, but those sizes are NOT stated by official SpliceAI source; treat as indicative only. Download may need BaseSpace account access.
not_now.adapter: Ensembl VEP SpliceAI plugin reads local SNV and indel VCF score tables and emits DS_AG/AL/DG/DL and DP_*; pin exact model/release/masking, validate GRCh38/reference and versioned controls. Avoid remote API variant calls.
not_now.why_not_now: Not a small package, account-mediated and license-restricted; resource version and exact official byte size need resolution before approval. Existing core cache has no SpliceAI files.

not_now.release: v1.7, currently the latest supported/downloadable production release on official download page; CADD-Splice v1.6 separately

files.name: gnomAD r4.0 genome indels to initiate local setup
all GRCh38 annotations for offline install

not_now.license_access: Official page: freely available for non-commercial use; commercial application requires license. No account stated.
not_now.adapter: Ensembl VEP CADD plugin exists; local tabix file and CADD-specific cache/annotation setup required. Pin score release and distinguish CADD raw/PHRED; indel subset is gnomAD genomes r4.0 and not exhaustive universal indels.
not_now.why_not_now: 81G even for pre-scored SNVs (and 336G supporting annotation bundle for offline recomputation); explicitly too large for the small supplement/budget window. Older 81.5 GiB approximation is essentially confirmed as 81G by official page.

not_now.release: FATHMM v2.3 legacy; official downloads describe original nsSNV algorithm, FATHMM-MKL, and separate datasets, without a dated packaged whole-genome VEP score release or file size.
not_now.assembly: No standalone assembly-pinned score file verified; FATHMM 2.3 is a legacy coding nsSNV predictor.
not_now.license_access: Official software license GPLv3. Authors state HGMD-trained pathogenic training data cannot be circulated; public SwissProt/TrEMBL alternative is linked. Do not claim an HGMD-derived database can be redistributed. Current legacy SQL/backend availability/size not verified.
not_now.adapter: Would require obtaining the exact permissible dataset/tool, building or attaching a separate local backend, versioning its inputs, and validating exact allele/protein mappings. dbNSFP current release contains FATHMM-XF coding, which is a distinct method, not the old FATHMM 2.3 score.
not_now.why_not_now: No official small, assembly-pinned and license-clear current score package identified; not an installable turnkey addition.

not_now.release: v5.4 (2026-08-01); user-reported Analysis 1 v4.9a remains historical and is not reused in Analysis 2.

files.name: full academic branch
files.size: about 50 GB; official page does not give exact release archive bytes

files.name: single tabix-indexed BGZF table per assembly
files.size: not stated; still requires gated download

not_now.data_basis: GENCODE 50 / Ensembl 116, newer than Analysis 2 VEP 115; transcript-version matching is required. Current v5.4 includes MetaLR, VARITY and FATHMM-XF coding (not legacy FATHMM v2.3).
not_now.license_access: Academic branch CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for academic/non-commercial use; institutional email registration and code are required. Commercial branch is paid; official tiers start at $5,000/year. Individual upstream score licenses still apply. No contract or registration accepted.
not_now.adapter: Official page offers GRCh38 tabix-indexed BGZF variant table ready for VEP/SnpSift; use version-matched dbNSFP plugin/fields and retain transcript-specific scores. Require a current authorized release manifest and exact key validation.
not_now.why_not_now: Whole database is ~50 GB and gated; current release is Ensembl 116 while pipeline cache is Ensembl 115. Cannot substitute the unverified old v4.9a user list or infer commercial rights.

not_now.release: Original VARITY publication-era precomputed scores; VEP plugin references an unversioned tar.gz URL.
not_now.assembly: VEP plugin states genomic lookups; direct official data page was inaccessible during audit, exact assembly/size/release/license not confirmed.
not_now.license_access: No authoritative terms could be verified from the inaccessible host. Current VARITY scores are available as a dbNSFP v5.4 score, subject to dbNSFP academic registration/commercial licensing and component terms.
not_now.adapter: VEP VARITY plugin exists for rare missense scores; needs local sorted score file and exact transcript/protein mapping.
not_now.why_not_now: No verified direct file metadata or current redistribution terms; use authorized dbNSFP release if later approved.

not_now.release: MetaLR is included in dbNSFP v5.4 (2026-08-01); no separate official independent score package found.

files.name: dbNSFP full academic package containing MetaLR
files.size: about 50 GB; no separate MetaLR archive

not_now.license_access: Same dbNSFP academic registration/CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 or paid commercial terms plus component terms.
not_now.adapter: dbNSFP VEP/SnpSift indexed table; preserve MetaLR score and rankscore as one correlated ensemble output, not as independent ACMG evidence.
not_now.why_not_now: No standalone downloadable MetaLR table and only identified current source is the gated ~50 GB database.

not_now.release: Original Yeo & Burge maximum-entropy splice-site model (2004); official MIT download URL returns 404 in audit.
not_now.assembly: No fixed assembly release; scores sequence windows against splice donor/acceptor motifs, so an offline adapter must derive strand-aware reference and alternate windows from pinned transcript/reference context.
not_now.license_access: Current official page unavailable and package license not verifiable. Do not substitute third-party reimplementations as the official tool without review.
not_now.adapter: Ensembl VEP MaxEntScan plugin exists; requires upstream score5/score3 tables/scripts, reference/transcript sequence windows and public variant-control tests. Keep raw REF/ALT score difference and score context, not pathogenicity class.
not_now.why_not_now: No accessible official archive with clear terms; do not install third-party package under an assumed license.

other_optional.note: Not confirmed as a lecture-required source and not automatically included; separate implementation/dependencies and validation needed. Do not add without explicit decision.

recommendation_to_sol: Only REVEL is a low-volume, official whole-score candidate (526 MB) with a shipped VEP adapter, conditional on intended use meeting explicit non-commercial terms. Do not initiate without confirming license applicability/adapter scope; no other listed database qualifies as small, publicly ungated, and turnkey. CADD 81G, SpliceAI 20GB indicative + BaseSpace access, dbNSFP ~50GB registration, FATHMM/VARITY/MaxEntScan package/terms uncertainty. No downloads were started by this audit.
